pages.title: Your first day on Salesmsg
pages.subtitle: Five steps from your invite to your first real conversation.

blocks.note: Your organization is already approved with the carriers.

paragraphs.text: Open the invitation email from Salesmsg, click the link and set your password. Done when you're logged in and can see your company's workspace and your inbox.
Add one contact by hand, or import your list. You can't text anyone until someone's in here. Done when at least one person you plan to text is in your contacts.
Pick a contact, write something real rather than a test, and send. Done when your message shows as delivered.

blocks.heading: Texts cost credits
blocks.intro: About one credit per 160 characters, unless the message uses special characters.

cards.label: One emoji or a curly quote
cards.caption: characters = 1 credit
cards.note: Doubles the cost of the message.

blocks.footnote: A curly quote pasted in from Word is enough to trigger it.

blocks.title: Make sure they opted in
blocks.text: A phone number in your CRM isn't permission to text. Only message people who agreed to hear from you.

pages.title: Make it real, then fix what breaks
pages.subtitle: The last two steps, plus the things that usually go wrong.

paragraphs.text: Ask a colleague to text your Salesmsg number, then reply from your inbox. This is the real test: it proves messages reach you as well as leave you.
Install the mobile app so you're reachable away from your desk, and the Chrome extension if you text from your browser. Done when you see the same conversations everywhere.

blocks.title: Working in HubSpot?
blocks.text: Add the Salesmsg App Card in your HubSpot settings; it won't appear on contact records until you do. Then check your HubSpot user is mapped to your Salesmsg user, because unmapped users can't send.

rows.definition: Usually the number or the content. Send your admin the contact and the time.
Check your notification settings, then your phone's. Still nothing, tell your admin which inbox.
Add it yourself in HubSpot settings. If it's there but won't send, you're not mapped.
They come across as they're used. Ask your admin for a bulk import.

paragraphs.text: Most of this they can fix in a minute. For anything else the Help Center is at help.salesmessage.com, or email support@salesmessage.com.
